svg.title: Bank Customer Service LLM — LoRA Post-training and Hybrid RAG
svg.desc: Offline model adaptation and parent-child knowledge indexing feed online hybrid retrieval and grounded generation. SFT results are verified. DPO artifacts and RAG evaluation results remain unavailable.
svg.text: Domain adaptation with LoRA · Evidence retrieval with Parent–Child RAG
Reconstructed config; final weights / logs missing
Every Child keeps its Parent context
Child text + parent_text + source metadata → chunks.pkl
Short Parents are indexed directly; BM25 is built from the same retrieval units.
Prompt instructs abstention when evidence is insufficient
535 cleaned test examples · base vs. LoRA SFT
Saved SFT results are verified. DPO outputs were not retained.
RAG code is present; corpus / index and evaluation results are absent.
Model adaptation shapes response behavior. Retrieval supplies document context at inference time.
